_about: Image tests (tools/images.py): each scene is drawn with midgard_runtime and these arguments plus --screenshot, then compared with <name>.png in this folder, or, with 'same_as', exactly with this run's image of an earlier scene. A scene may set its own tolerance (0-255 per colour channel) and max_bad (the fraction of pixels allowed past it).

scenes.name: bright
scenes._about: The demo scene three times brighter: highlights roll off towards white instead of clipping (tone mapping).

scenes.name: far_50km
scenes._about: The demo scene 50 km from the world's origin: camera-relative rendering makes it look exactly like the demo at the origin.

scenes.name: far_10000km
scenes._about: 10,000 km out, where a float steps by a metre: still the same picture.

scenes.name: materials
scenes._about: Spheres from smooth to rough (left to right) and plain to metal (top to bottom).

scenes.name: textures
scenes._about: One object per material texture: base colour, normal map, metal/roughness, occlusion, emissive. Its textures are magnified on screen, which drivers filter alike; near the spheres' edges they shrink, where drivers may choose mip levels differently, so up to 1% of pixels may differ.

scenes.name: compressed
scenes._about: The textures scene with every texture through KTX2 (Basis UASTC) and the GPU's compressed format (BC7 here; RGBA where a GPU reads none). The same allowance as textures.

scenes.name: lights
scenes._about: A red point light and a blue spot light in a dim scene.

scenes.name: shadows
scenes._about: Sun shadows on flat ground, from 2 to 45 metres away (all four cascades), and a plank's shadow apart from it. Drivers filter shadow edges a little differently, so up to 1% of pixels may differ.

scenes.name: shadows_curved
scenes._about: Sun shadows on a small planet where 'up' leans 50 degrees from y: the cascades are built in the local up frame. The same allowance as shadows.

scenes.name: sky_day
scenes._about: The analytic sky by day (sun 35 degrees up, behind the camera) over a wide plain, with a thin haze that hides the farthest pillar in the sky's own colour.

scenes.name: sky_sunset
scenes._about: The sun 3 degrees up, ahead: its disc and glow, a warm horizon under a dark sky, long shadows, and fog lying low over the plain (thinning upwards).

scenes.name: shadows_phone
scenes._about: The shadows scene at the phone quality tier: two smaller cascades over 30 m, so the farther pillars cast none, and harder shadow edges.

scenes.name: sky_sunset_phone
scenes._about: The sunset at the phone quality tier: the same sky and fog, shorter and harder shadows.
